fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: If prior treatment with chemotherapy or radiotherapy or surgery has occurred: Prior chemotherapy or radiation must have concluded > 21 days prior to the start of study treatment. Exception: study treatment can start within 2-3 days following GKS [gamma knife surgery] or whole brain radiation therapy [ WBRT], as long as patient is not experiencing ongoing/residual AE's related to GKS or WBRT at discretion of treating physician.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout windows with various procedure-specific exceptions and investigator discretion are fuzzy criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy > or equal to 6 months.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No previous or concurrent malignancy is allowed except for adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer, in situ cervical cancer, or other cancer for which the patient has been disease free for the past 3 years.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior malignancy history rules with multi-year disease-free exceptions cannot be represented by a standard typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of < or equal to 5 sites amenable to SBRT
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: SBRT site counting rules are complex and study-specific.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Medications prohibited while receiving concurrent SBRT: gemcitabine, Adriamycin, VEGF or BRAF inhibitors.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: List of prohibited medications with a holding exception window is not a simple prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Uncontrolled inter-current illness. This includes, but is not limited to: ongoing or active infection; symptomatic congestive heart failure (NYHA class III or IV); unstable angina pectoris or new onset angina that began within the last 3 months; cardiac ventricular arrhythmias requiring anti-arrhythmic therapy; thrombotic/ embolic events such as cerebrovascular accident, including transient ischemic attacks within the past 6 months;
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General uncontrolled comorbidities and specific cardiac/vascular events with various timeframes are not a single typed check.
